meta.parties: De Saram Et Al v. Vander Poorten

rules.statement: A co-debtor cannot as a rule be made liable in solidum unless there is a special agreement to that effect.
rules.supporting_quote: "In the absence of evidence of such intention, the parties, even in the earlier civil law, were not correi but were each entitled or liable only in respect of his rateable share. in the Roman-Dutch Law, following herein the -latest Roman Law, a co-debtor cannot as a rule be made liable in solidum unless there is a special agreement to that effect."
